author: Ifmyante
text:
Now, to try to answer that question.

I think by now we all understand that the derivatives market is a scam.

If we sold our planet, we couldn't come close to getting paid the value of the market.

The market allows bankers to sell what isn't theirs in order to drive
value down. Invert the pairs and the do the same by going long.

Both of these things are highly suspicious, but they're not proof that the market is manipulated. Ominous signs, yes. Proof, no.

The guys in the academy discuss price every day. When they talk about
it, they say "if I were moving the market, I'd................", and
more often than not, that's the way it pans out. That's still not proof.

What we do have proof of, is the fact that this entire planet is
controlled by a small number of people, who lie, cheat and murder on a
grand scale to keep and expand their control.

With trillions of dollars being lost every day on the markets, it just
makes sense that these lowlifes would be in on that action too. They're
the ones who set up the game in the first place. We mustn't forget that
the mafia played a massive part in the politics of America, and after
WWII were were brought in on the running of Europe too. These guys have
always loved their rigged gambling dens, so can you imagine their glee
at the thought of running the market too!

Now, how many of us get into trades and get stopped out a pip before price shoots in the right direction?

That's absolutely no coincidence!

We've been taught, very wrongly, how to trade. We see it all over the
internet. We've been taught through propaganda, just like in every other
 walk of life.

We have the Federal Reserve and ECB causing big moves in the market.
These people are counterfeiters, crooks, who have the power to move the
market with one statement. Can any of us imagine that these criminals
wouldn't click money into existence just before they deliver the news,
and make themselves billions for the moment's work?

I suppose though that I've just made a compelling case that there could
be a group of criminals moving price, without actually proving it.

Ten wildebeest jumped into the murky, crocodile infested river. Five of
them got to the other side. Can we prove that the crocodiles killed the
unfortunates? I guess not. Can we know for certain that they did?
Absolutely!
